guided_measure.title: Let’s measure it together.
guided_measure.intro: You measure the fitted hardware. We’ll take care of how your curtain is made.
guided_measure.hardware_title: Is your curtain track or pole already fitted?
guided_measure.hardware_copy: We’ll measure the hardware in its final, fitted position.
guided_measure.opening_copy: Choose the opening your fitted hardware serves.
guided_measure.heading_copy: For a fitted track, Wave changes where your drop measurement begins.
guided_measure.unknown_heading: Let’s identify your heading first. Wave starts at the bottom of the track; other track headings start at the top. We can help you choose the correct starting point.
guided_measure.track_width_copy: Measure the full width of your track, from one end to the other.
guided_measure.pole_width_copy: Measure the pole between the finials. Leave the decorative ends out of your reading.
guided_measure.bay_width_copy: Measure the full length of your fitted bay track from where it starts to where it finishes, following the track around the bay.
guided_measure.finish_title: Where would you like your curtain to finish?
guided_measure.finish_copy: Choose the effect you have in mind. Your tape reading will stay separate from this choice.
guided_measure.short_detail: Choose a clear finishing point above the floor.
guided_measure.floor_detail: Choose the point at floor level where the curtain should finish.
guided_measure.soft_break_detail: A little fabric meets the floor with a soft break. Ask us to confirm the physical measuring endpoint before taking a reading.
guided_measure.puddle_detail: More fabric rests on the floor. Ask us to confirm the physical measuring endpoint before taking a reading.
guided_measure.finish_review_copy: We’ve kept your finish preference and width. For Soft Break or Puddle, CurtainsUK needs to confirm the physical endpoint with you before you measure the drop. Don’t add extra centimetres yourself.
guided_measure.track_drop_title: Start at the top of the track.
guided_measure.track_drop_copy: Measure from the top of the track to where you want your curtain to finish.
guided_measure.wave_drop_title: For Wave, start at the bottom.
guided_measure.wave_drop_copy: For Wave curtains, measure from the bottom of the track to where you want your curtain to finish.
guided_measure.pole_drop_title: Start at the bottom of the pole.
guided_measure.pole_drop_copy: Measure from the bottom of the pole to where you want your curtain to finish.
guided_measure.bay_drop_title: Start at the top of the bay track.
guided_measure.bay_drop_copy: Measure from the top of the track to where you want the curtain to finish.
guided_measure.track_help: Place the tape at one physical end of the fitted track and measure all the way to the other. Record that full reading; do not halve it or add anything.
guided_measure.pole_help: Start where the pole meets the inside of one finial and finish where it meets the inside of the other. The decorative finials stay outside the measurement.
guided_measure.bay_help: Keep the tape following the entire fitted track, including its bends and any physical returns, all the way to its other end. Do not measure straight across the bay or measure the walls. A photo can help us understand your setup, but cannot replace your tape reading.
guided_measure.top_help: The start dot sits on the top surface of the track body. It does not start at the ceiling or at a hanging hook. Follow the vertical line to your chosen physical finishing point.
guided_measure.wave_help: The start dot sits on the bottom surface of the track body. It does not start at the top of the track or at a hanging hook. Follow the vertical line to your chosen physical finishing point.
guided_measure.pole_drop_help: The start dot sits on the bottom surface of the pole itself. It does not start at a ring or hook. Measure vertically to your chosen physical finishing point.
guided_measure.finish_help: Choose a physical endpoint you can identify with the tape. If the floor is uneven, the endpoint is unclear, or an obstruction affects the curtain, ask CurtainsUK to review it before you continue.
guided_measure.general_help: If you cannot identify the fitted hardware or your setup is unusual, we can help. You do not need to guess. A photo may help explain the setup; it does not replace a tape reading.
guided_measure.still_unsure: Still unsure? Keep your readings and contact us before continuing. Nothing is sent automatically.
guided_measure.stop_copy: Your curtain measurements depend on the final position of your track or pole. Have the hardware fitted first, then come back and we’ll measure it together.
guided_measure.bay_pole_title: A bay needs a fitted bay track.
guided_measure.bay_pole_copy: This journey measures curtains for an existing fitted bay track. If you have a pole or need a new bay track, contact CurtainsUK for help with your setup.
guided_measure.bay_wave_copy: Wave is not recommended for bay windows. Choose a supported track heading or ask CurtainsUK for guidance before measuring.
guided_measure.check_copy: Check both tape readings against the lines you measured. We haven’t adjusted your numbers.
guided_measure.heading: Heading preference
guided_measure.check_review: Your confirmed readings still need CurtainsUK’s review before a production specification is agreed.
guided_measure.bay_review: Bay measurements need CurtainsUK review. A photo of the fitted route is recommended for context.
guided_measure.brief_copy: Your raw readings and design intent are recorded below. Save a copy to share with CurtainsUK when you’re ready.
guided_measure.brief_local: Saved on this browser only. It has not been sent to CurtainsUK or added to an order. Download a copy before changing devices or clearing browser data.
guided_measure.copy_failed: Copy is unavailable here. Download or print your brief instead.
guided_measure.storage: Your progress is saved on this browser. No measurements are sent automatically.
guided_measure.storage_failed: This browser cannot save progress. Keep this page open and download your brief when you finish.
guided_measure.invalid: Enter a positive tape reading in cm, using digits and a decimal point if needed. Do not add a unit or calculate an allowance.
guided_measure.recheck: Check this reading against the current measurement line, then Continue to confirm it.
guided_measure.check_incomplete: Please complete and recheck your width and drop before confirming.
guided_measure.noscript: Guided Measure needs JavaScript to show each measurement step. Contact CurtainsUK and we’ll help you measure your fitted track or pole.
guided_measure.not_manufacturing: Customer confirmation is not a production specification.
